question_text: Was the NSA network outage a hack?
answer_text: No public evidence says it was. The Director of National Intelligence says it was not a cyberattack and blames PHP patching; the House Intelligence Committee's top Democrat has seen no evidence of a malicious actor.
label: Debunked

question_text: Is the NSA's classified network back up?
answer_text: Not clear. CBS News reported on Nov 18 that it was back up; NBC News and MS NOW reported on Nov 19 that it was still partly down.
label: Unverified
what_would_settle_it: An NSA statement on when full service returned.

question_text: Are the NSA, FAA, Microsoft and Apple outages connected?
answer_text: No credible source says they are. The DNI and Secretary Rubio say they are separate incidents with no common attacker.
label: Debunked
